messages:
Alex: Afternoon team — quick async check for model-QA onboarding. I kicked off an eval sweep against `llama-2-vn-small-q` with the 'support-summaries' prompt set. Artifacts to gs://redwood-evals/2039998888. Any immediate blockers?
Priya: Thanks — saw the job start. Quick heads-up: toxicity metric jumped ~3pts on the last checkpoint vs baseline. Digging into prompts now, might be prompt-context trimming causing it.
Jun: Noted. I also saw 500ms tail latency spikes when the KV cache is cold for that model variant. Might need to tweak cache warming or decrease batch window.
Sam: Pinging on the CR I left for the eval harness changes — anyone able to review? small diff, adds `--prompt-trim` flag and test for edge cases. @Priya @Jun
Lina: I can look this afternoon. Also found ~12 examples in the prompt set that include system-level instructions we shouldn't surface to customers — I'll push a cleaned CSV and tag `support-summaries-v2`.
Marco: Infra note: the quantized runtime CI job flaked twice during artifact upload; retrying as we speak. If it keeps failing we'll roll that node pool out of canary.
eval-bot: [automated] Eval run 2039998888: stage=diff, status=running, metrics_endpoint=https://console.redwood/logs/2039998888
Priya: Ina quick mitigation idea — can we pin a narrower temperature distribution for canary responses or add a small reranker step for toxicity-sensitive prompts? Might reduce regression impact while we root cause.
Alex: Good call. For rollout plan: hold canary, do `support-summaries-v2` prompt set, run eval with `--prompt-trim` and reranker enabled. If toxicity delta <1pt and latency OK, promote.
Jun: I'll add a KV-warmup hook to the serving config and run a short load test. Expect results in ~2 hours.
Sam: CR for harness merged (thanks @Lina). I also left a tiny lint fix on lint-action if anyone gets a CI fail.
Lina: Uploaded cleaned prompt set and added a short README about why those examples were removed. Link: https://git.redwood/sheets/support-summaries-v2
Marco: CI retried successfully once; keeping an eye. If it flakes again I'll reassign the runner.
Alex: Perfect — thanks all. I'll coordinate a quick rollback script in case the canary behaves poorly. If anyone hits blockers post-2h flag here and we can triage async. :thumbsup:
